description: Shared Renovate policy for all CarlAllenn repos. Policy rationale lives in this repo's README; repo-specific rules stay in each repo's renovate.json. The 7-day minimumReleaseAge is one leg of the three-layer age-gate policy (Renovate + pnpm + mise, all 7 days - see templates/pnpm/README.md); security fixes bypass it via osvVulnerabilityAlerts. Weekly Monday schedule batches all non-security activity into one wave; osvVulnerabilityAlerts ignores the schedule so CVE fixes still land same-day.

customManagers.description: Track mise's own version pinned in workflows (mise-action version input)
Generic: '# renovate:' comments above *_VERSION env pins in workflows
Track min_version in mise.toml so the floor keeps pace with the CI-pinned mise

packageRules.description: Non-major updates for semver-stable (>=1.0) packages automerge as silent branch pushes once CI is green; a PR only appears if CI goes red
0.x packages: automerge patches only - SemVer allows 0.x minors to break, so those stay manual PRs

Digest and pin-only updates automerge as PRs via GitHub platform automerge - branch-type automerge starved on churning digests (rebase races with main pushes; postgis went 24h+ green-but-unmerged). Platform automerge merges the instant CI is green, no Renovate run needed. Requires 'Allow auto-merge' in each repo's settings.
Group mise-managed tool pins into one PR (rust toolchain rides separately)
Rust toolchain: own PR, never automerged - bumping MSRV is a deliberate decision

Majors never automerge, so their PRs sit open as the visibility mechanism - sometimes for weeks. config:best-practices brings :rebaseStalePrs (rebaseWhen: behind-base-branch), which rebases every one of them on every push to main, and each rebase costs a full CI run per open major. Measured in monumental-archive (#150): one parked branch accumulated 26 rebases. Rebasing buys nothing here - a major is not waiting to automerge on green, it is waiting for a human - so it only needs to happen when the branch actually conflicts. This makes automatic what the stop-updating label was doing by hand, late and inconsistently.
Biome rides with the linters group (absent from Renovate's group:linters preset as of 2026-07)
